subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis Imaging Biomarkers and Lesion Characterization
subtopics.description: Research on advanced MRI techniques (quantitative susceptibility mapping, phase imaging, central vein sign) and corneal confocal microscopy as biomarkers for lesion characterization, neurodegeneration, and disability in multiple sclerosis. Includes paramagnetic rim lesions, myelin water fraction, and structural disconnectivity.
subtopics.short_description: Advanced MRI and corneal confocal techniques for lesion characterization, neurodegeneration, and disability tracking in multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as Biomarker in Multiple Sclerosis and Autoimmune Disease
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy to quantify corneal nerve fiber loss, axonal degeneration, and immune cell infiltration as biomarkers of neurodegeneration and disease activity in multiple sclerosis, systemic lupus erythematosus, and rheumatoid arthritis.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal nerve fiber loss and immune cell infiltration as biomarkers of neurodegeneration in MS, lupus, and rheumatoid arthritis.

subtopics.label: Multiple Sclerosis Treatment Outcomes and Disease-Modifying Therapies
subtopics.description: Clinical studies evaluating disease-modifying therapies for multiple sclerosis, particularly natalizumab and tofacitinib, including real-world effectiveness, cognitive outcomes, racial/ethnic disparities in treatment response, and CNS biomarkers of disease activity.
subtopics.short_description: Real-world effectiveness, cognitive outcomes, and racial disparities in disease-modifying therapy response for multiple sclerosis.

subtopics.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis Cardiovascular Risk and Comorbidity Management
subtopics.description: Research on cardiovascular disease risk, hyperlipidemia screening, dementia incidence, work disability, and perioperative management in patients with rheumatoid arthritis, including disparities in care and behavioral interventions to reduce CVD risk.
subtopics.short_description: Cardiovascular disease risk, hyperlipidemia, dementia incidence, and perioperative management in rheumatoid arthritis patients.

subtopics.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis Patient-Centered Outcomes, Disparities, and Clinical Management
subtopics.description: Studies examining racial and ethnic disparities in RA medication use, patient self-assessment of disease activity, lay health worker interventions, depression screening, thoracic manifestations, and synovial tissue pathotyping in rheumatoid arthritis.
subtopics.short_description: Racial and ethnic disparities in RA medication use, self-assessed disease activity, and lay health worker interventions.

subtopics.label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus Pathogenesis, Pregnancy Outcomes, and Clinical Features
subtopics.description: Research on SLE disease mechanisms including type I interferon signaling, mitochondrial retention, Langerhans cell dysfunction, and clinical studies on pregnancy morbidity, antiphospholipid syndrome management, frailty, and patient-reported experiences in lupus.
subtopics.short_description: Type I interferon signaling, mitochondrial dysfunction, and clinical studies on pregnancy morbidity and frailty in SLE.

subtopics.label: Mechanisms of Autoimmunity and Pathogenic Autoreactivity
subtopics.description: Translational and mechanistic studies on the molecular basis of autoimmunity, including posttranslational modifications triggering self-reactivity, B cell-reactive germinal centers, PDIA3 epitope-driven autoreactivity, and the broad spectrum of pathogenic autoreactive immune responses.
subtopics.short_description: Posttranslational modifications, B cell germinal centers, and epitope-driven pathogenic autoreactive immune responses.

subtopics.label: Psoriasis, Psoriatic Arthritis, and Spondyloarthritis
subtopics.description: Research on the pathogenesis and treatment of psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, including IL-23-driven skin and joint disease in mouse models, gut microbiome regulation of sulfasalazine efficacy in IBD-associated spondyloarthritis, and IgG-seq identification of immune-reactive bacteria in Crohn's disease with spondyloarthritis.
subtopics.short_description: IL-23-driven skin and joint disease pathogenesis, gut microbiome regulation, and treatment of psoriatic and spondyloarthritis conditions.

subtopics.label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor-Related Autoimmune and Inflammatory Adverse Events
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on immune-related adverse events (irAEs) from immune checkpoint inhibitors, including myocarditis treatment with infliximab, ophthalmic irAE consensus definitions, cumulative incidence in renal and urothelial cancers, and the impact of pre-existing immune-mediated inflammatory disease on ICI outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical management of irAEs from immune checkpoint inhibitors, including myocarditis, ophthalmic toxicity, and pre-existing inflammatory disease.

subtopics.label: Thyroid Autoimmune Disease: Graves' Disease and Thyroid Autoimmunity
subtopics.description: Clinical research on autoimmune thyroid conditions including Graves' disease surgical complications, thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulin in concomitant papillary thyroid cancer, thyroid replacement therapy effects on IVF outcomes in TPO-antibody-positive women, and thyroid eye disease severity.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical outcomes, thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins, thyroid eye disease severity, and IVF outcomes in autoimmune thyroid conditions.

subtopics.label: Scleroderma, Interstitial Lung Disease, and Pulmonary Fibrosis
subtopics.description: Research on interstitial lung disease and progressive pulmonary fibrosis in the context of systemic autoimmune disease, including patient-centered outcomes in ILD, patient education needs in scleroderma-ILD, and identification and management of progressive pulmonary fibrosis.
subtopics.short_description: Patient-centered outcomes, education needs, and progressive pulmonary fibrosis management in systemic autoimmune-associated ILD.

subtopics.label: Immune Thrombocytopenia, Vasculitis, and Vascular Autoimmune Conditions
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on immune thrombocytopenia diagnosis and treatment selection, leukocytoclastic vasculitis with linear IgG deposition, anti-TNF therapy-associated renal lesions, idiopathic systemic capillary leak syndrome pathogenesis, and iloprost use in vascular autoimmune conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis and treatment of immune thrombocytopenia, leukocytoclastic vasculitis, and idiopathic systemic capillary leak syndrome.

subtopics.label: COVID-19-Associated Inflammatory Syndromes and Immunomodulatory Treatments
subtopics.description: Research on COVID-19-related inflammatory conditions including MIS-C in children, treatment with immunomodulators (anakinra, infliximab, IVIG), hydroxychloroquine failure in rheumatic disease patients, and COVID-19 vaccine-related immune reactions.
subtopics.short_description: MIS-C in children, immunomodulatory treatments, and vaccine-related immune reactions in COVID-19 and rheumatic disease patients.

subtopics.label: Autoimmune Gastritis, Celiac Disease, and Gastrointestinal Autoimmunity
subtopics.description: Clinical and pathological studies on autoimmune gastritis identification, celiac disease comorbidities (eosinophilic esophagitis, frailty in older adults, corneal Langerhans cells), and concurrent gastrointestinal autoimmune conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical and pathological studies of autoimmune gastritis, celiac disease comorbidities, and concurrent gastrointestinal autoimmune conditions.

subtopics.label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease Clinical Management and Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research on treatment strategies, comorbidities, and clinical outcomes in inflammatory bowel disease, including biologic therapies, venous thromboembolism risk, and disease phenotypes.
subtopics.short_description: Biologic therapies, venous thromboembolism risk, and clinical outcomes across inflammatory bowel disease phenotypes.

subtopics.label: Innate Lymphoid Cell Biology in Inflammation and Autoimmunity
subtopics.description: Studies examining the roles of innate lymphoid cells (ILCs), including ILC2s and ILC3s, in regulating intestinal inflammation, neuroinflammation, and immune homeostasis.
subtopics.short_description: Roles of ILC2s and ILC3s in regulating intestinal inflammation, neuroinflammation, and immune homeostasis.

subtopics.label: Store-Operated Calcium Entry and Immunomodulatory Signaling
subtopics.description: Research on store-operated calcium entry (SOCE) pathways and their pharmacological modulation as therapeutic targets in immune and inflammatory conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Store-operated calcium entry pathways and their pharmacological modulation as therapeutic targets in immune and inflammatory disease.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Neurological, Vascular, and Cutaneous Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on the pathophysiology and clinical manifestations of COVID-19 affecting the nervous system, vasculature, and skin, including complement activation and neuro-ophthalmic sequelae.
subtopics.short_description: Pathophysiology of COVID-19 affecting the nervous system, vasculature, and skin, including complement activation and neuro-ophthalmic sequelae.

subtopics.label: Immunoglobulin Biology: IgA Glycomics and Anti-CD4 IgG in HIV
subtopics.description: Research on immunoglobulin structure and function, including IgA glycosylation genetics and the role of anti-CD4 IgG autoantibodies in HIV-associated immune dysfunction and brain abnormalities.
subtopics.short_description: IgA glycosylation genetics and anti-CD4 IgG autoantibodies in HIV-associated immune dysfunction and brain abnormalities.

subtopics.label: Small Molecule Immunomodulators Targeting RORγt and Tryptophan Metabolism
subtopics.description: Studies on novel small molecule modulators of immune pathways, including RORγt nuclear receptor ligands and tryptophan-derived immunomodulatory metabolites, as potential autoimmune therapeutics.
subtopics.short_description: Novel small molecule modulators of RORγt and tryptophan-derived metabolites as potential autoimmune disease therapeutics.

subtopics.label: Autoimmune Encephalitis and Neuropsychiatric Autoimmune Conditions
subtopics.description: Research on autoimmune neurological conditions including anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and blood-brain barrier dysfunction in neuropsychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia.
subtopics.short_description: Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, blood-brain barrier dysfunction, and immune-mediated neuropsychiatric disorders including schizophrenia.
